title: The 10 Best Robot Vacuums Under $300 in 2026
h1: The 10 Best Robot Vacuums Under $300 in 2026
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for robot vacuums under $300 in 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at robot vacuums under $300 in 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: iRobot Roomba i3+ EVO Self-Emptying
products.blurb: Key specs: Self-emptying, Systematic navigation, Rubber extractors.
strengths: Rubber extractors handle pet hair without tangling
Systematic row-by-row navigation covers floors completely
iRobot app with scheduling and room assignment
limitations: No camera-based obstacle avoidance, will run over small objects
Basic mapping without room labeling at this tier
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Eufy X8 Pro Self-Empty Robot Vacuum
products.blurb: Key specs: iPath laser navigation, 4000Pa twin-turbine suction, Self-empty station.
strengths: Twin-turbine 4000Pa suction handles pet hair and embedded debris on low carpet
Self-empty station, self-emptying at this price is exceptional value
Multi-floor map support
limitations: No mopping function at this price
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Eufy RoboVac G30 Slim
strengths: No subscription required, full app functionality without ongoing payment
Smart Dynamic Navigation (not random)
BoostIQ auto-increases suction on carpet
limitations: 2000Pa is the minimum adequate suction, upgrade to 2500Pa+ for carpets with embedded debris

products.name: Shark IQ Robot Self-Empty
products.blurb: Key specs: IQ Nav mapping, Self-empty, 200-min runtime.
strengths: IQ Nav mapping for systematic room cleaning
Self-emptying at Shark's mid-range price point
Shark app with scheduling and no-go zones
limitations: Bristle brush tangles with long pet hair
No LiDAR, camera-based navigation is less accurate in low light
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Ecovacs Deebot N8 Pro+
products.blurb: Key specs: LiDAR, Mop function, No-go zones.
strengths: No-go zone support to protect carpeted rooms from the mop
2600Pa suction with mop for hard floor households
Self-empty station included
limitations: Larger dock footprint than vacuum-only models
App can be less polished than Roomba or Roborock
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: iRobot Roomba 694
products.blurb: Key specs: WiFi, Alexa, Dirt Detect.
strengths: Lowest price for an iRobot WiFi robot vacuum
Dirt Detect increases cleaning on dirty areas
iRobot brand reliability
limitations: Random navigation, misses significant floor area per cleaning cycle
No mapping, no systematic navigation, no self-emptying

products.name: iRobot Roomba i1 (no self-empty)
products.blurb: Key specs: Systematic navigation, Rubber extractors, iRobot app.
strengths: Systematic row navigation without the self-empty premium
Rubber extractors for pet hair
limitations: No mapping, room navigation without room labeling

products.name: Ecovacs Deebot N8 Pro
strengths: 2300Pa suction handles hardwood and low carpet
Multi-floor map support
limitations: Obstacle avoidance less capable than Roomba models
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Deebot OZMO 920
strengths: LiDAR mapping with mopping at value price
Multi-room support with selective room cleaning

products.name: Proscenic 850T Robot Vacuum
strengths: 3000Pa suction at a budget price, higher than most competitors at this range
Combined vacuum-and-mop function included
limitations: Brand support and repair ecosystem below Roomba and Roborock
Gyro navigation less precise than LiDAR-based systems

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
